subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Coffee: The Second Most Traded Commodity
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Coffee: The Second Most Traded Commodity.

hook.text: Coffee is the world's second most traded commodity after crude oil. Over 2 billion cups are drunk daily.

buildup.text: The global coffee industry is worth over $450 billion. It employs 125 million people from farm to cup.

discovery.text: Yet 80% of coffee farmers earn less than $2 per day. The value concentrates at the top of the supply chain.

twist.text: A $5 latte contains about 10 cents' worth of raw coffee beans. The farmer's share is shockingly small.

climax.text: This imbalance drives poverty, migration, and deforestation in the world's biggest coffee-growing nations.

punchline.text: Billions in profit, pennies for farmers. Coffee's economics are broken.

quiz.question: What percentage of a $5 latte goes to raw coffee beans?
